skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general concepts of capital markets.
Identify and understand various instruments used in capital markets.
Understand the structure and operations of derivatives markets.
Understand the structure and operations of bond markets.
Understand the structure and operations of stock markets.
Understand the role and operations of venture capital funds.
Understand key theories related to capital markets.
Understand the process of raising capital through securities issuance.
Understand investment activities conducted on capital markets.
Understand the structure and operations of debt and leasing markets.
Analyze and make informed decisions about investments in capital markets.
Develop the ability to independently study and learn new material.
Work effectively in teams to solve problems related to capital markets.
Apply critical thinking to identify and solve problems in capital markets.
Demonstrate discipline and responsibility in class and group activities.
Communicate effectively in seminars and presentations.
